chose: A ticket's answer scenes: the whole ticket's (a take, a silence, or an unheard take), then one per point answered by a take of its own, in point order, numbered across the essay as deep dives are. A ticket answered only point by point carries a silence with neither guess nor unheard, which is said nowhere and has no scene; it is allowed only when every point has its own answer.
options: whole answer first, then each point's
each point's in place of the whole answer, one scene per point always
one answer scene playing the takes one after another
gray: The server requires every ticket to have `answer.kind` take or silence, so a ticket with no whole take needs a silence; whether to show it, and where point takes go, is a choice the owner would see in the video.
undo: Reorder in essayScenes; ids are counted, so scene ids of mixed essays would change.
